card.text: M55 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 5,350 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 55 is a globular cluster in the south of the constellation Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M55 is drawn as 5,713 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
